verdict.rationale: LobeChat's chat interface itself is natural-language driven (agents built via 'one sentence to start', task scheduling, chat-based agent creation), and a Command Menu exists for quick actions, supporting natural-language operation of core features. However, evidence is mostly marketing copy without hands-on verification that all product operations (settings, admin tasks, deployment) can be done purely via natural language rather than UI/CLI. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of NL command coverage across the full product surface, detail on how the Command Menu/NL commands map to actual app actions, and evidence beyond self-reported docs.
